rationale: The matched node-ID grammar diagnostic preserved near-perfect MLP reports but only 8/100 and 6/100 actions succeeded. Test whether a small action-supervised continuation improves use of the readable states.

action_data.label_rule: Choose one uniformly sampled legal distance-decreasing successor per ordered training pair; keep that label fixed. Evaluation accepts all successful successors.

report_replay.selection: Seeded permutation: first retain one report for every node and role, then fill to 80 from remaining examples.

training.compute_matching: Both conditions use 1600 sample presentations and 50 updates; action supervision replaces half the report-only control presentations.

evaluation.test_reuse: Previously inspected pairs; post-hoc exploratory result, not a new confirmatory test.
evaluation.decision: Require an action gain over equal-budget report continuation under the same decoding condition, and inspect report retention plus heldout-template behavior. No claim of geometry use or cross-graph generalization.
